title: Original audio resource metadata and voice pool

0x4f63ec.name: operator new
0x4f63ec.reason: The C runtime heap ends in operating-system calls.

coverage_exempt.reason: The zero voice result passes null to original list remove at 0x4b44be, which unconditionally reads null+4; no normal return exists in this bounded readable-memory domain.
This post-remove null-voice branch cannot be reached without the preceding original list remove dereferencing a null node.
Allocation failure passes a null node to original prepend at 0x4b49de and then divides and stores through a null resource; no normal return exists in this bounded readable-memory domain.

equivalent_mutants.reason: The mutant shifts an initial zero scratch write from descriptor+0 to descriptor+4. Both words are overwritten unconditionally with size and flags before the first external call; the descriptor is stack-local and has no observer between these writes.

The mutant shifts an initial zero scratch write from descriptor+4 to descriptor+8. Both words are overwritten unconditionally with flags and byte length before the first external call; the descriptor is stack-local and has no observer between these writes.

Dropping the initial zero write to descriptor+8 cannot change any permitted input: the same scratch word is unconditionally overwritten with the saved byte length before the first external call and no intervening instruction reads it.

limits: Operator new is a fixture; allocation exceptions and guest exception unwinding are outside this ordinary return contract.
Cases supply physical DirectSound COM methods through function pointers; no real audio buffer or device is created.
Diagnostics execute unchanged original 0x4b4ed0 with reporting globals 0x54130c, 0x541310, 0x541314 and 0x541318 zero; host reporting paths are outside this domain.
Voice acquisition requires successful creation when no reusable voice exists because its failure path dereferences a null list node.

Resource creation requires successful allocation after successful nonnull COM creation, a nonzero format byte rate and readable 18-byte format storage; malformed memory and division faults are outside the domain.
RIFF parsing covers bounded readable chunk storage and nonwrapping progress; truncated or malicious sizes that escape readable memory are outside the domain.
notes: Eight full original seeds are owned. The canonical source is separate so the existing app-facing legacy audio implementation remains intact. The third stack argument of 0x4b48b0 is unused; 0x4b42e0 consumes one mode argument despite incomplete decompile signatures.
